jobs.occupation: Head of Transportation & Foreign Trade EMEA (f/m/d) - Power Tools (Leiter/in - Export)
jobs.description:
Job Description: Techtronic Industries (TTI) is a world leader in
cordless technology spanning power tools, accessories, hand tools,
outdoor power equipment, as well as floorcare & cleaning products. Our
focus is on end-users that range from professionals in the industrial,
construction and infrastructure sectors to DIYers in home improvement,
repair, and maintenance. TTI’s powerful brand portfolio includes
MILWAUKEE®, RYOBI®, AEG® ̶ recognized worldwide for their deep
heritage and innovative product platforms of superior quality. The
company maintains a global manufacturing and product development
footprint, with record world-wide sales of approximately US$15.2
billion and around 50,000 employees in 2026. Hiring exceptional people
is a top focus at TTI. This drives a high-performance culture across
all levels of our organization and helps to achieve our vision of
being number one in the industries we serve. Our unique high-speed
decision-making process supports our acute focus on developing
superior products and meeting high customer expectations. We view our
winning culture as a competitive advantage that powers our growth. To
strengthen our team in Winnenden (Stuttgart area) as soon as possible,
we are looking for a Head of Transportation & Foreign Trade EMEA
(f/m/d) - Power Tools Your responsibilities: The Head (f/m/d) of
Transportation and Foreign Trade EMEA is responsible for managing
relationships with transportation service providers, focusing on the
following key areas: Contract management Identification of efficiency
gains via managing continuous improvement programs KPI management
Leading the Transportation and Import/Export teams More specifically,
in this role, you will have end-to-end responsibility for: Oversight
of inbound and outbound freight activities and outbound carrier
performance Ownership of the transportation and P&L budget Lead
import/export strategy with the Foreign Trade Office Management
Performance monitoring and cost reporting Invoice verification,
control, and documentation management Transportation claims management
and resolution Assist sales business units to find delivery solutions
to customers/consignees requests Implementation of X-docking models
Identification and implementation of new transportation routes Driving
continuous improvement initiatives: Leading and coordinating projects
across all key areas of responsibility Providing support for the
opening, expansion, and transfer of distribution centers Your profile:
Relevant experience in transportation management areas Solid knowledge
in the foreign trade domain Proven track record of process improvement
and change management Experience in team leading Willingness to travel
as required per the business (from 25% to 50%) Competent knowledge of
MS Office, especially Excel Good command of English What we offer: An
interesting position with an attractive company – recognized as a
"top employer” by kununu Flexible working hours, hybrid working
options, and 30 days of annual leave Capital-forming benefits and
company pension scheme EGYM Wellpass corporate fitness membership
Employee discounts, JobRad bicycle leasing, complimentary fruit, water
and coffee, and additional attractive benefits Are you interested?
Then send your application stating your earliest possible starting
date and your salary expectations to jobs@tti-emea.com or apply
directly via our careers page. Naturally, we will treat your
application with the utmost discretion. We look forward to getting to
know you! Techtronic Industries ELC GmbH Human Resources – Agnese
Cesarini · Max-Eyth-Straße 10 · 71364 Winnenden
www.ttigroup.com/careers/global-career-opportunities

Job Description EuroChem is one of the leading manufacturers of
fertilizers, with a long-standing presence in Europe and many
countries overseas. With our broad product portfolio, we offer plant
nutrition solutions for every application, including field
fertilization, fertigation, and foliar fertilization. The Supply &
Operations Planning Manager is a central integrator between the
production site and the regional and local Sales organizations. As
part of the regional team in Mannheim, you take full responsibility
for demand planning, supply balancing, and commercial scenario
development for a defined product group and/or a specific production
site in Europe. We are looking for a committed and experienced: Supply
& Operations Planning Manager (m/w/d) Your Key Responsibilities in
detail: Lead S&OP Planning for a Defined Product Portfolio or
Production Site Own the end-to-end S&OP planning cycle for your
assigned products/sites, ensuring a robust, transparent and efficient
planning process while balancing the interdependencies of continuous
fertilizer production, customer service, production stability,
logistics constraints, working capital and financial performance
Integrate commercial priorities into the planning process by
evaluating business opportunities, optimizing contribution margins,
prioritizing markets and ensuring the optimal deployment of
constrained production capacities Facilitate commercial
decision-making in close collaboration with the Commercial Lead
(responsible for the production site or the European commercial
organization) Commercial & Operational Planning Validate demand
forecasts, evaluate commercial opportunities, identify supply gaps or
surpluses and align production capabilities with Sales Managers and
the Commercial Lead Allocation & prioritization: Define & adjust
product allocations and market priorities (planned product volume/
price-positions) in close collaboration with Sales and Supply Chain
Execution to establish delivery commitments and operational priorities
Support working capital optimization by incorporating Order-to-Cash
(OTC) cycle-time considerations into planning decisions using sales
input and historical performance data Inventory, Production & Shipment
Monitoring Tracking regional inventory targets to balance service
levels, production stability and capital efficiency Monitor the
Production–Shipment Plan (actual vs. planned performance), identify
deviations early and initiate necessary corrective actions, such as
accelerated delivery or reallocation of volumes Your Qualification:
Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Industrial
Engineering or comparable field 2 to 5 years professional work
experience in Supply Chain Planning would be an advantage Strong
analytical and commercial thinking skills; ability to balance
trade-offs and drive decisions Structured, proactive and hands-on
approach in dynamic environments Very good communication and
stakeholder management skills High IT affinity; strong Excel skills;
experience with S&OP planning tools is a plus Fluent English (written
and spoken); additional languages are beneficial Enjoy working in a
collaborative, supportive team culture Kontakt Like to work
independently and on your own responsibility? Entrepreneurial thinking
and acting is a matter of course for you? Then we should get to know
each other! Please send your detailed CV in English to Human
Resources, attention Andreas Wagner Andreas.Wagner@eurochem.group

About the company My client is a leading high-tech startup
specializing in the research and development of products in the field
of artificial intelligence and autonomous systems . The goal is to
transform pioneering research results into marketable products and to
translate the latest insights of AI into practical applications . With
innovative solutions and technologies, they strive to ensure that
their customers can take a leading position in the constantly evolving
AI landscape. (Senior) AI Engineer - Kotlin, Java, TypeScript (m/w/d)
In permanent full-time employment Salary: 60.000 – 120.000 €
brutto / Jahr Location: Munich Ref. 31411 The Role You will work
directly with the CEO as a technical generalist , removing technical
blockers across the entire technology stack . You will develop
features, configure systems, build integrations, investigate technical
challenges, and create prototypes—exactly where the greatest impact
is currently needed. This is not a pure engineering role and not a
pure product role . It is operator work with technical substance : you
will read and write code, design architectures, work with
infrastructure, and reliably bring solutions into production. The
decisive factor is not processing tickets but sustainably resolving
technical blockers and quickly validating new ideas . You work
AI-natively : Claude Code, agentic workflows, and automation tools are
part of your daily toolkit. Your Responsibilities Identifying and
independently resolving technical blockers in customer projects,
product development, or infrastructure Implementing features in the
Kotlin backend or TypeScript frontend and targetedly expanding
existing systems Configuring customer-specific workflows,
integrations, and automations Implementing new concepts as prototypes:
AI agents , integrations, internal tools, or dashboards Reviewing pull
requests with a view to system boundaries, architecture, and component
transitions Investigating production issues together with the
engineering team and taking responsibility for their resolution until
completion Consistently utilizing AI tools: Claude Code, agent chains,
MCP servers , and customized automations are part of your standard
toolkit What the role is NOT Not a traditional software developer
position with responsibility for a single codebase – you work where
technical solutions create the greatest value Not a pure product
management role – you technically implement solutions yourself
instead of exclusively documenting requirements Not a data science or
ML research position – the focus is on transforming AI technologies
into marketable products Not a remote-only position – collaborating
within the Munich team is an important part of the role Not a role for
people who consider AI tools optional – modern AI development tools
are part of your daily way of working Your Profile Degree in computer
science, business informatics , or comparable practical experience
Confident handling of existing codebases in Kotlin, Java, TypeScript
,or Python – you can implement features independently and expand
existing systems AI-native way of working : You use Claude Code or
comparable tools daily , develop your own small tools, and know both
the strengths and limitations of AI assistants Systemic thinking : You
understand components, interfaces, error scenarios, and technical
trade-offs Enjoyment of ambiguous situations : Requirements evolve,
priorities change, and clarity arises through the work Personal
responsibility : You take ownership of a blocker and drive it to a
solution – even if you have to learn new things along the way
Excellent written and spoken English skills and German language skills
Residence in the Munich area or willingness to relocate Nice to have
Experience with LLM integration (RAG, tool use, agent architectures,
evaluations) Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, or
self-hosting Experience in regulated industries such as insurance,
automotive, healthcare, or finance Contributions to open-source
projects Self-developed tools, AI agents, or automations that go
beyond simple demo projects What you are offered Attractive and
competitive salary package with performance bonuses Comprehensive
benefits , including healthcare and pension plans Career opportunities
in a rapidly growing area of AI development Involvement in pioneering
projects within an AI-driven corporate environment The opportunity to
become part of a dynamic team at the forefront of technological
innovation Contact Information Nils Hohler n.hohler@karesources.com
Tel. 0049 228 286 59 410 www.karesources.com

About EIT RawMaterials As the world moves towards a greener future,
the demand for raw materials—minerals and metals—is set to
increase immensely over the next three decades. Europe faces a
critical challenge in securing a stable supply of these essential
resources. This challenge is where EIT RawMaterials steps in. EIT
RawMaterials is at the forefront of driving innovation and
sustainability in the raw materials sector. As an Innovation Community
within the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), we
collaborate with over 300 partners across industry, academia, and
research institutes. Together, we forge dynamic, long-term
partnerships to develop innovative solutions that meet Europe's
growing demand for raw materials. Tasks Information Management &
Architecture Design, implement, and continuously improve the
organization's information and document management architecture. Own
the Microsoft 365 and SharePoint information management environment.
Ensure integration with ERP, CRM, business applications, and the wider
IT landscape. Define information architecture, metadata, taxonomy,
access controls, and governance standards. Ensure scalable, secure,
and future-ready information management solutions. Document Management
& Governance Lead the development and operation of the Document
Management System (DMS). Establish governance for document
organization, metadata, permissions, lifecycle management, and
information classification. Define standards for document storage,
retrieval, version control, and collaboration. Ensure information
remains accessible, structured, and compliant throughout its
lifecycle. Compliance & Process Automation Translate legal,
regulatory, and business requirements into effective information
management solutions. Manage document retention, archiving, and
records management processes. Ensure compliant, audit-ready
information storage and governance. Design and optimize automated
workflows, approvals, electronic signatures, and lifecycle processes.
Drive continuous improvements in efficiency and user experience using
Microsoft 365 technologies. Digital Workplace & User Enablement Own
information management and digital workplace solutions within IT
Operations. Promote best practices for collaboration, document
management, and knowledge sharing. Evaluate and implement enhancements
that improve governance and usability. Deliver training, user
documentation, onboarding materials, and guidance for Microsoft 365,
SharePoint, DMS platforms, and emerging technologies such as Copilot.
Vendor Management & Security Manage implementation partners,
consultants, and external service providers. Ensure solution quality,
governance, security, and alignment with business objectives. Oversee
implementations, enhancements, and ongoing solution performance.
Ensure compliance with IT security standards, ISO 27001, and
information governance requirements. Collaborate with security, legal,
and compliance teams to mitigate information risks and embed privacy
and security by design. Profile Strong experience in designing
information architectures and document management solutions, including
structured storage, collaboration, and lifecycle concepts. · Hands-on
expertise in Microsoft 365, particularly SharePoint, with familiarity
in modern tools such as Copilot Studio or comparable platforms. ·
Solid understanding of data structures, metadata models, and access
management concepts, with the ability to design scalable and
user-friendly solutions. · Experience in establishing governance
frameworks and applying "compliance-by-design” principles within
systems and processes. · Good understanding of system integrations
and application landscapes, including how to connect information
management solutions with business systems (e.g. ERP, databases, SaaS
tools). · Proven ability to design and implement automated workflows
and digital processes, improving efficiency and standardisation. ·
Experience in driving user adoption and delivering
training/enablement, ensuring effective and consistent usage of
systems across the organisation. · Experience in working with
external vendors or implementation partners, ensuring quality delivery
and alignment with requirements. · Awareness of information security,
data protection, and risk mitigation practices, and ability to
incorporate them into system design. · Excellent communication
skills, with the ability to act as the central coordination point
between business stakeholders and external IT providers for
information management and governance activities. Additional
Information & Our Recruitment Process Commitment to Diversity : EIT
RawMaterials is committed to diversity and inclusion. We encourage
applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of background.
Employment Type : Fixed-term contract with the possibility of
extension. Position Location: Berlin, Germany & Riga, Latvia The
position will stay open until a successful candidate is chosen.
Application Review: Our team thoroughly reviews each application.
Please make sure to submit your CV in English. Initial Interview (30
minutes): Meet with the hiring manager and recruitment team. Second
Interview (60 minutes): Second interview with a presentation on a
relevant topic to the hiring manager and the HR team. Offer : If
successful, receive an offer to join our team. Additional contact
details Contact Shushanik Sargsyan Talent, People and Culture

Science meets innovation: Develop modern analytical and microbiological testing strategies and take innovative methods from the scientific concept through to practical application!
Our client in 88400 Biberach an der Riß is currently looking for a

Senior Scientist Biological Analysis and Microbiology (m/f/d)

The position is initially a fixed-term contract for 18 months - with the option of a permanent role with the client

What you can expect from us:

- Monthly salary: outside the pay scale
- Variable performance-related pay / bonus
- 37.5-hour working week
- Holiday pay and Christmas bonus
- Up to 30 days statutory holiday entitlement
- A role with significant responsibility within an innovative pharmaceutical company
- Comprehensive induction by a motivated team of colleagues
- Opportunities for professional development
- Staff canteen and team events

Here are the tasks that await you:

- In this role, you will develop, assess, and implement analytical and microbiological testing strategies to ensure product quality, product safety, and informed CMC decision-making throughout the development process
- By contributing to the scientific direction and providing expert input to CMC subteams, you will ensure the timely delivery of high-quality analytical and microbiological results
- You will support the evaluation, validation, and implementation of alternative, innovative, rapid, and automated microbiological methods, including the use of AI-based tools to optimize testing processes and data evaluation
- As part of the role, you will lead or contribute to technology, innovation, and continuous improvement projects to strengthen analytical and microbiological capabilities in a GMP-regulated environment
- You will assess scientific results, prepare accurate reports and documentation, support regulatory submissions where applicable, and collaborate closely with internal and external partners to ensure scientific alignment and effective knowledge exchange

What you will need:

- PhD in Biology, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Chemistry, or a related Life Science discipline, preferably with relevant experience in the pharmaceutical industry, alternatively, a Masters degree with substantial professional experience in an industrial environment
- Strong background in biological drug development, quality control, and microbiological product safety, with experience in preparing or contributing to regulatory documentation
- In-depth knowledge of analytical methods (e.g. HPLC-SEC, HPLC-CEX, CGE, CZE, icIEF, potency assays) and microbiological testing methods (e.g. sterility testing, bioburden determination, endotoxin testing)
- Solid understanding of working within GMP-regulated environments, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards
- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, excellent communication and presentation skills, and the ability to effectively collaborate in cross-functional and international teams
- Fluent English required, German skills are a plus
Does this job description appeal to you?
If so, please send your application to: biberach@hey-cleo.de

Please notice: Communication will be in German!

GPU/serverless), full-stack development around AI applications, DevOps/MLOps practices (CI/CD, monitoring, model versioning), and performance optimisation across cost, latency, and scalability

Essential Requirements

- University degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, or related technical field (or equivalent practical experience)
- Portfolio of production AI/ML systems you've built and deployed

We are looking for a

Senior Tech Consultant – Microsoft Dynamics (m/f/d)

(unlimited, full-time) Join our team at one of our locations in Berlin, Baden-Baden, Verl or Tallinn – flexible working conditions available

Shape the future of our Microsoft Dynamics landscape and help drive our digital transformation. As a Senior Tech Consultant in our Dynamics Team, you will be at the heart of designing, stabilizing, and evolving our Dynamics 365 ecosystem — from Customer Engagement to Finance & Operations, including integrations, governance, and cross-tenant transformations.In this senior role, you will act as a trusted advisor, lead complex technical initiatives, steer platform evolution, and design future-proof solutions that are deeply embedded in our business processes.
Your expertise ensures that our Dynamics platform remains stable, resilient, compliant, and ready to scale with the growing demands of the organization — enabling innovation, operational excellence, and measurable business impact.

What will be the challenges in the role:

- Partner with business and IT stakeholders to guide strategic and transformational initiatives across the Microsoft Dynamics landscape (D365 CE, D365 FO, Customer Insights, Marketing, Field Service).
- Establish and further strengthen the AI-Driven CRM System with an agentic approach.
- Translate business needs into clear functional and technical requirements, including user stories, interface specifications, and integration concepts.
- Lead and shape our Dynamics strategy, including governance frameworks, solution standards, customization guidelines, and high-quality processes.
- Drive platform stability and compliance, ensuring data integrity, system performance, and adherence to security and regulatory requirements.
- Coordinate testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement activities, and support business stakeholders during major releases and platform changes.
- Develop and present solution concepts, reference architectures, and technical roadmaps that enable informed decision-making.
- Collaborate with internal and external partners to integrate Dynamics with surrounding systems (Power Platform, Jira/Atlassian, Data Platform, SAP, and external services).
- Guide and coach internal team members to strengthen our Dynamics expertise and establish best practices across development, operations, and governance.Manage relationships across business units, product owners, and cross-functional IT teams to ensure transparent communication, aligned priorities, and smooth delivery.

What will help to succeed in the role:

- Extensive hands-on experience (5+ years) with Microsoft Dynamics 365 (CE, FO, Customer Insights/Marketing) including application lifecycle, customization, data models, security roles, and integrations.
- Developer Languages like Java Script etc. are welcomed.
- Deep understanding of requirements engineering, process analysis, solution design, and technical documentation for Dynamics-based transformations.
- Proven expertise in platform governance, compliance, and quality management across complex Dynamics environments.
- Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.Strategic and analytical mindset, able to balance technical depth with business-oriented decision-making.
- Experience with agile methodologies, project management practices, and solution architecture principles.
- Proactive, solution-oriented approach with a strong ownership mentality and the ability to work under pressure in complex multi-tenant setups.
- Fluent in English; German is a plus.
